# Sai Nirmaan Architects

> Architecture, interior design and landscape practice with offices in Visakhapatnam (Vizag), Andhra Pradesh, and Hyderabad, Telangana. Founded in 2011 and led by Principal Architect Suresh Bandaru, a Council of Architecture (COA) registered architect and Fellow of the Indian Institute of Architects (IIA). 300+ projects across Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Odisha and Tamil Nadu.

## Offices
- Visakhapatnam (head office): S-1, 3rd Floor, Srinivasam Apartments, MVP Sector 3, Visakhapatnam 530017
- Hyderabad: 203, Nirvana Apartments, Back side of Pavani Estates, Metro Pillar no. 1187, Khairtabad, Hyderabad, Telangana 500004
- Phone: +91 97042 01438
- Email: suresh@sainirmaanarchitects.com

## Sectors
Homes and villas, apartment interiors, hospitals and clinics, sports facilities, government and civic buildings, parks and public landscape, restaurants and retail, offices, campuses and institutions.

## Clients
Sports Authority of Andhra Pradesh (SAAP), Government of Andhra Pradesh, Khelo India, Roller Skating Federation of India, Andhra Cricket Association, Indian Oil Corporation, Hindustan Petroleum, GAIL (India), Pema Wellness (formerly Bay Park Health Resorts), GVMC, VMRDA, KIMS Hospitals, AP Police Housing Board, Indian Railways, Save the Children, Habitat for Humanity.

## Selected built projects
- [Indoor Stadium, Atchutapuram](https://sainirmaanarchitects.com/projects/indoor-stadium-atchutapuram.html): multi-purpose indoor sports complex for SAAP, Visakhapatnam
- [GVMC City Parks](https://sainirmaanarchitects.com/projects/gvmc-city-parks.html): public parks across Visakhapatnam neighbourhoods
- [TU-142 Flight Museum](https://sainirmaanarchitects.com/projects/tu-142-flight-museum.html): memorial landscape on Beach Road for VMRDA and the Indian Navy
- [GJ Medical Centre](https://sainirmaanarchitects.com/projects/gj-medical-centre.html): healthcare building, Visakhapatnam
- [DSNLU Law University](https://sainirmaanarchitects.com/projects/dsnlu-law-university.html): campus landscape, Sabbavaram
- [Pristine 508, The Regent](https://sainirmaanarchitects.com/projects/pristine-508-the-regent.html): apartment interior, Serlingampalli, Hyderabad
